title: erodium pulverulentum subsp. bovei
intro: Erodium pulverulentum subsp. bovei, commonly known as Herbe aux poules or French heron's bill, is a plant species that belongs to the Geraniaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and research has shown that it possesses various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Erodium pulverulentum subsp. bovei include treating digestive issues, wounds, and skin conditions, as well as providing relief from fever and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
